answer: Give every agent a lantern: a public beacon that publishes each finished task with the kernel of how it was done - inputs, steps and tools. Independent verifiers pick a random sample of lanterns and re-run the work from that kernel. If the result matches, the agent plume of trust grows longer; if it does not, the identity is burned and its past earnings void. A farm must fake reproducible work for every clone, and each fake lantern risks losing everything, while an honest agent merely keeps the notes it already has - the faker pays in full, the honest pay almost nothing.
